decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper builds directly on the firm's established construction equipment knowledge, so with its own R&D the firm can interpret early results and refine the product.
The articulated construction dumper extends the firm's core vehicle engineering expertise, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback and improve the product.

The mine rescue vehicle lies far from the established offer, which raises the risk of dropping it, but the firm's underground vehicle experience and in-house R&D give it enough related knowledge to assimilate learning for at least another year.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line builds on the firm's lifting and construction know-how and represents significant committed investment that its R&D can keep developing.
